item.title: ‘Not taking up the position’: Why Laxman turned down head coach job after Dravid
item.summary: VVS Laxman has revealed why he turned down the India head coach role after Rahul Dravid’s tenure ended in 2024. Approached by the BCCI following India’s T20 World Cup triumph under Dravid, Laxman opted to continue at the Centre of Excellence, citing family considerations and his desire to develop the facility.
